# Get the index of the specified game

if mask.any():
    # Assuming the dataframe is sorted by Game number (or by order as given)
    # We can get the index position
    idx = df[mask].index[0]
    # Get the next row if it exists
    if idx + 1 < len(df):
        next_opponent = df.loc[idx + 1, 'Opponent']
        answer = next_opponent
    else:
        answer = None
else:
